answer: Tie each agent identity to a refundable stake bond, like paying a smooth marble deposit at the gate: minting a thousand sybils then means locking a thousand bonds, and any node caught double-signing gets slashed. Pair this with proof-of-work attestation as hard as forging ferrous metal, so honest peers verify each other cheaply while a flood of fakes costs the attacker real capital that scatters like chaff in a gale.
